column1: # comment: "Concepts slice alignments (Principle 5 \u2014 by reference only). AXIOMATIC GROUNDING: gmeow:Concept is a gufo:Kind subclass of gmeow:SocialObject, and gmeow:ConceptCategorization is a gufo:SubKind subclass of gmeow:StandpointClaim; these subsumptions are ontology, documented here rather than asserted as mapping rows. SKOS: gmeow:Concept is a closeMatch to skos:Concept, and gmeow:subsumes is a closeMatch to skos:broader after accounting for domain inversion. The bridge is authored in the mapping DSL, not as an OWL axiom in the module. ontolex: gmeow:Concept is a relatedMatch to ontolex:LexicalConcept as a forward bridge to the future lexicon slice; a lexical concept is language-bound and narrower. Rosch prototype theory and G\u00e4rdenfors conceptual spaces are referenced in prose only (no resolvable RDF namespace suitable for SSSOM rows)."

column6: gmeow:Concept is a socially sustained representational object, not the gUFO universal; skos:Concept is the SKOS unit of knowledge organization
ontolex:LexicalConcept is language-bound and narrower than the socially sustained gmeow:Concept; bridge to the future lexicon slice
gmeow:subsumes points from broader to narrower concept; skos:broader points from narrower to broader. Direction inverts, so the closeMatch is via the mapping DSL, not an OWL axiom
